stimulus.title: A tank drains through a hole in its base
stimulus.html:
The depth h of water in the tank, in feet, t minutes after the hole is opened, satisfies the differential equation in the table
QuantityValue
dhdt\frac{dh}{dt}−15h-\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{h} feet per minute
h(0)h(0)16 feet

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Use the line tangent to the graph of hh at t=0t = 0 to approximate the depth of the water at t=1t = 1 minute.

rubric.point: Slope at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 0</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left.\frac{dh}{dt}\right|_{h = 16}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><msqrt><mn>16</mn></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{16}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -\frac{4}{5}</annotation></semantics></math>, and the tangent line <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h = 16 - \frac{4}{5}t</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: dh/dt = -0.8 at t = 0 used in a linear approximation

parts.sample: At <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><msqrt><mn>16</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dh}{dt} = -\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{16} = -0.8</annotation></semantics></math>. The tangent line is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0.8</mn><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h = 16 - 0.8t</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≈</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0.8</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>15.2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h(1) \approx 16 - 0.8 = 15.2</annotation></semantics></math> feet.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find d2hdt2\frac{d^2h}{dt^2} in terms of hh. Determine whether the approximation in part (a) is an overestimate or an underestimate. Give a reason for your answer.

rubric.point: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{d^2h}{dt^2}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -\frac{1}{5} \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{h}} \cdot \frac{dh}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>10</mn><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mo>⋅</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -\frac{1}{10\sqrt{h}} \cdot \left(-\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{h}\right)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>50</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{1}{50}</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: 1/50, with the chain rule factor dh/dt shown

rubric.point: Underestimate: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>50</mn></mfrac><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{d^2h}{dt^2} = \frac{1}{50} > 0</annotation></semantics></math>, so the graph of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h</annotation></semantics></math> is concave up and lies above its tangent line.
accept: underestimate because h is concave up on [0, 1]

parts.sample: By the chain rule, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{d^2h}{dt^2}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -\frac{1}{5} \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{h}}\frac{dh}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>10</mn><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -\frac{1}{10\sqrt{h}}\left(-\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{h}\right)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>50</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{1}{50}</annotation></semantics></math>. Since <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{d^2h}{dt^2} > 0</annotation></semantics></math>, the graph of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h</annotation></semantics></math> is concave up, lies above its tangent line, and 15.2 feet is an underestimate.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the rate at which the depth is changing when the water is 9 feet deep. Indicate units of measure.

rubric.point: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><msqrt><mn>9</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dh}{dt} = -\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{9} = -\frac{3}{5}</annotation></semantics></math> feet per minute.

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><msqrt><mn>9</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.6</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dh}{dt} = -\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{9} = -0.6</annotation></semantics></math> feet per minute: the depth is decreasing at 0.6 feet per minute.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Find h(t)h(t), the particular solution to the differential equation with h(0)=16h(0) = 16. At what time is the tank empty?

rubric.point: Separates variables: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>h</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h^{-1/2}\,dh = -\frac{1}{5}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>.

Uses the initial condition: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>16</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\sqrt{16} = 0 + C</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C = 8</annotation></semantics></math>, and solves: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>10</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h(t) = \left(4 - \frac{t}{10}\right)^2</annotation></semantics></math>.

Empty when <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>10</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4 - \frac{t}{10} = 0</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 40</annotation></semantics></math> minutes (the solution holds for <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>40</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0 \le t \le 40</annotation></semantics></math>).

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dh}{\sqrt{h}} = -\frac{1}{5}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\sqrt{h} = -\frac{t}{5} + C</annotation></semantics></math>. At <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 0</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>16</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\sqrt{16} = C</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C = 8</annotation></semantics></math>. Then <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mi>h</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>10</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{h} = 4 - \frac{t}{10}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>10</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h(t) = \left(4 - \frac{t}{10}\right)^2</annotation></semantics></math>, valid while <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>10</mn></mfrac><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4 - \frac{t}{10} \ge 0</annotation></semantics></math>. The tank is empty when <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>10</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4 - \frac{t}{10} = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 40</annotation></semantics></math> minutes.
